_comment: Players whose 2026/27 name differs from their 2025/26 one. The league reissues player ids each season, so identity carries by name; anything short of an exact match is confirmed by a human before it lands here. Keys are the current-season name, values the earlier one.
_not_matches_comment: Pairs the matcher keeps suggesting that a human has confirmed are different people. Listed so they stop reappearing in the review list on every refresh.
